scripts.tauri:linux: sh -lc 'set -a; . src-tauri/.env; set +a; APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 tauri dev'
scripts.test:full: npm run test:front && npm run test:back
scripts.tauri:build:win:x32: dotenv -e src-tauri/.env -- tauri build --target i686-pc-windows-msvc && script.bat
scripts.tauri:build:win:x64: dotenv -e src-tauri/.env -- tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && script.bat
scripts.tauri:build:mac:x64: dotenv -e src-tauri/.env -- tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin && sh script.sh
scripts.tauri:build:mac:arm64: dotenv -e src-tauri/.env -- tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin && sh script.sh
scripts.tauri:build:linux:x64: sh -lc 'set -a; . src-tauri/.env; set +a; APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage' && sh script.sh
